description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)] and [Snipe Charge Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Full Charge Shot
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.90 each), 100% additional critical chance, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Tricky Barrage
description.text: One single ranged attack (6.00) capped at 99999, causes [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Snipe Charge Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Snipe Charge after using a Machinist ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
